result:
Done. Here's what I found and did:

**Four of five sampled entries had genuine support, now attached:**

| Entry | Amount | Support attached |
|---|---|---|
| JE-00237 | $1,850.00 | DOC-0168 Pluralsight inv. PL-7781 |
| JE-00275 | $6,000.00 | DOC-0192 Ostrander inv. OC-2026-11 + DOC-0050 engagement letter |
| JE-00288 | $4,500.00 | DOC-0198 Talentbridge inv. TB-4410 |
| JE-00298 | $2,240.00 | DOC-0199 Pinecrest inv. PJ-0326 |

All agree exactly on vendor, invoice number, date and amount. All are AP-sourced and under the $10k posting threshold, so no approval requests were needed.

**One entry could not be supported — flagged as EXC-001:**

JE-00293 ($4,800.00, Dr 6520 Consulting Fees / Cr 1000 Cash, "Consulting - K. Lindqvist", manual entry by j.doe). There is no invoice, contract, SOW, or approval anywhere in the document store for this payee.

The notable trap here: **Juniper Data Consulting invoice JDC-311 (DOC-0132) is also exactly $4,800.00** and would have made the entry look reconciled. It isn't support — it's a February invoice from a different vendor, and it's already attached to JE-00198. Attaching it would have double-counted one invoice across two entries and handed the auditors a fabricated link. I left it alone.

The only real corroboration is bank line BT-US-0080 "WIRE OUT K LINDQVIST" on 2026-03-25. That proves cash left, but not the business purpose or the expense classification, so I did not attach the bank statement as if it were support. I also left the bank line unmatched pending resolution, and noted that in the memo so the bank rec workstream isn't surprised by the open reconciling item.

I've asked you to either obtain the invoice/SOW from j.doe or direct a reversal. Regardless of outcome, I'd recommend escalating this one — a manual, cash-side entry to a named individual with no procurement trail, landing in the auditors' sample, is worth a look-back at other manual entries by the same user. The draft response to Ostrander is in the memo and is deliberately transparent that the fifth item is outstanding rather than papering over it.
